calibration.interpretation: Common retained-support calibration plan only. Few hole rows replaced within episode; no calibration fitting now; no hole conditional or selected-action guarantee.
calibration.rule: keep each original selected row if outside hole; otherwise uniformly choose one eligible row in the same episode, using replacement RNG in sorted group order

controls.calibration: same hole-excluding calibration rows for all three prospective training conditions
controls.estimand: Hole minus count/state-stratified random removal isolates structured label deletion beyond coarse retention; residual continuous-state imbalance may remain. Full minus hole alone mixes sample size, action coverage and state density.
controls.exposure: Later replay, BC and uncertainty fitting use only condition-retained tuple IDs; shared hole-excluding calibration. Retained logged states/successors can reflect earlier removed actions; this is tuple-label withholding, not counterfactual recollection or removal of all history exposure. No sequence learner/history features. Actor/target action queries are unlabeled and must be logged, not treated as labeled leakage.
controls.normalization: For later training, fit one common normalization on intersection of hole/random retained training rows; shared across full/hole/random; never on removed rows, calibration or probes. Existing frozen broad-trained checkpoint normalization is preserved only for this diagnostic.
controls.random_rule: same retained count as hole in each stratum, sampled once without replacement
controls.reward_successor_balance: descriptive only; changed labels are consequences of action removal
controls.state_balance: hole versus random physical-coordinate mean difference divided by original training std

purpose: Development design-validity screen; not BCA efficacy or held-out confirmation

rationales.choice: Single zero-centered central-quartile construction. Symmetry around neutral thrust and recorder mean preserves population conditional BC mean; quarter probability leaves75percent of high-side actions and25percent in eachflank. h=.25 is not selected from memo slope/gap predictions or BCA outcomes. Other drafts with h=.1 and a fitted-value rationale remain untouched.
rationales.collection_prerequisite: Strict fixed-state empirical joint-action support would require a separately authorized clustered-anchor recorder with randomized one-step branches and independent episode groups. Current dataset supports known-law conditional mask and relative-state geometry, not that stronger claim.
rationales.development_context: Candidate shape was informed by known baseline exposure and failed negative band. Actor ranges, fitted-value memo and previous gate results were already seen. This is not independent benchmark discovery or untouched confirmation.
rationales.exposure: At least1percent highload freeactions in2episodes and100highload steps excludes incidental off-trajectory-only relevance; not an efficacy guarantee.
rationales.finite_sample: Symmetric removal preserves BC mean only in the ideal recorder population, not exactly in finite rows. Report actual full/hole/random mean actions byload as descriptive balance; do not select region by these outcomes.
rationales.locality: Replace the rejected absolute-radius claim with a different, explicitly weaker training-typicalness question.32 distinctepisode references per20cells boundCPU and reduce singletrajectory dominance;64NN and existing32rows/8episode/actionbandcounts retained.95thhigherquantile and80percent hurdle are fixed engineering conventions, not precision guarantees.
rationales.population_support: At verified epsilon=.25, requested action density is1/16 on[-1,1]^4 independent of state/time. Retained density is proportional to p(s,t)*p(a)*indicator(not hole). State support remains; high-side state density is reweighted by.75. Exact executed mass has float32 rounding boundary effects; empirical masks/counts define removed labels.
rationales.stop: Complete one fixed batch even on scientific failure; source/runtime/integrity violation stops immediately; never promote failed region or release training hold.
rationales.value: 1returnunit at25percent highanchors kept as practical full-Qpi resolution, not a predicted pass. Edges/center/+-0.5 are set by recorder quartiles, all within linear pre-stall magnitude.

reference.continuation: candidate first action, then same frozen deterministic current actor; discount exponent0 at query; no terminal bootstrap
reference.other_action_coordinates: same frozen actor coordinates1:4 in all six candidates
reference.parity: 100 environment steps plus direct comparisons at t0,25,50,99; no private time mutation
reference.state: reconstruct exact float64 state by replaying recorded prefix from original episode seed; assert every float32 observation matches

region.action_rule: executed float32 commands promoted to float64; abs(a0)<=0.25
region.construction: central quartile of uniform recorder a0; not fitted to model values
region.load_rule: float32 observation coordinates10 and11 separately promoted to float64 then added
region.threshold_meaning: upper observed load side, not extreme-current or changed-dynamics condition

supersedes_for_this_gate_only: New development construction; old failed region, reservations and all training holds remain intact

support.interpretation: relative training-state typicalness plus marginal-a0 occupancy; not dense full-state coverage, joint4D empirical action support, or a95percent guarantee
support.locality: 64th-neighbor RMS distance <= training-reference 95th higher quantile in same ten-step/load stratum
support.reference_exclusion: exclude entire reference episode for each reference distance; exclude anchor episode for queries
support.reference_selection: SHA256 of UTF-8 central-quartile-reference-v1:<source_row_id>, sorted ascending then rowID; first row per distinct episode; first32; no action/value inputs
support.standardization: original training physical observations, population mean/std in float64; std<1e-12 replaced by1
